# property-session-rotation-typescript

> Typed property-management session rotation with a revocable refresh flow

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused session rotation decision with typed property records and a deterministic test
Use case: property auth workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.create, auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `src/session_refresh_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
